tiktok, instagram, whatever eats your day.

posts.title: i pay for 12 apps, these 5 do all the work
posts.caption: arco keeps every task in one place and the day gets planned in 30 seconds, with focus mode putting every distraction away and blocked hours repeating it every weekday. superwhisper turns one shortcut into clean text inside any app, so a message you would type for two minutes takes fifteen seconds. granola records the call and rewrites your rough notes from the audio, so two words typed in the meeting come back as a written summary. claude takes the messy dictated version and hands back the clean draft, so you edit something that exists instead of facing a blank page. cleanshot x reads the text inside a screenshot and copies it out, so an error on a photo of a screen becomes something you can paste. #productivity #apps #aitools #mac

posts.title: the tools i use to do a full day of work by noon
posts.caption: arco keeps every task in one place and the whole day gets planned in 30 seconds, with focus mode putting every distraction away. a manus task runs on its own cloud machine and keeps going after you close the tab, so you hand off the long job and come back to a finished file. n8n can be hosted on your own machine, so a workflow reaches local files and private apis a cloud tool cannot touch. a cloudflare tunnel puts your local server on a public https url with no port opened, so you send someone the link while the site still runs on your laptop. any past vercel deployment can be promoted back to production in one click, so a bad release is undone in seconds instead of rebuilt and shipped again. #productivity #tools #aitools #buildinpublic

posts.title: the tools i use to run my business at 19 years old
posts.caption: nineteen, no team, and this is the whole stack. arco holds every task i have and the day takes 30 seconds to plan, then focus mode puts every distraction away and blocked hours does it on a schedule. tag codex on a pull request and it reviews the diff line by line, so bugs get caught before the merge with no one else on the team. dependabot watches your packages and opens the upgrade for you, so a security fix arrives as something to merge instead of something to find. dev mode in figma hands you the spacing, colour and radius of any layer, so you build the screen from numbers instead of a screenshot and a guess. framer has analytics built into the site with no script to install, so you see which page they land on and where they leave without ever leaving the editor. #buildinpublic #indiedev #solofounder #aitools

posts.title: this is how you lock in when you don't feel like it
posts.caption: arco focus mode blocks every app on my list for the whole session, so the phone stops being a decision while the timer runs. ask claude for a quiz on what you just read and it builds a working one, so you click through questions instead of rereading the page. raycast floating notes keeps a note above every window on one hotkey, so the next step stays on screen while you work somewhere else. cleanshot x captures park in a corner overlay instead of piling on the desktop, so you drag the diagram into your notes without saving a file. any canva design opens out into an infinite whiteboard, so the whole topic gets mapped before you write a word. #discipline #focus #productivity #studytok

posts.title: how i ship in a weekend what used to take a month
posts.caption: a month of work, done between friday night and sunday. i keep every task in arco and the day takes 30 seconds to plan, then focus mode puts every distraction away and blocked hours does it on a schedule. you can start a codex task from the chatgpt app on your phone and it runs in the cloud, so a task is still going while you are out. github pages serves a folder in the repo as a live site on push for free, so the landing page ships the same weekend as the app with no host to set up. put the issue id in the branch name and linear picks it up, and the issue moves itself to done the moment the pull request merges. stripe tax works out the sales tax for the buyer's country at checkout and flags where you have crossed a registration threshold. #buildinpublic #indiedev #solofounder #aitools

posts.title: 4 hours a day is 60 full days a year
posts.caption: i did the math once and could not unsee it. 4 hours of scrolling a day is 28 hours a week, 60 waking days a year. grayscale and app limits never held because every fix asked me to decide again at the worst moment. now the feeds lock on a schedule, 9 to 12 and 7 to 10 on weekdays, and the block does not ask how i feel. three weeks in my screen time is under 90 minutes. the app is arco, planner and app blocker in one. #screentime #digitaldetox #focus #productivity
